auto_authorize_when_all_true: The next action is the unique legal successor under the currently frozen protocol.
The required state is only WAIT_FOR_USER_AUTHORIZATION or AUTH_REQUIRED.
The action stays inside the already-frozen budget.
The action preserves all currently frozen safety and experiment boundaries.
The action does not alter the experimental design, comparison contract, or hard gates.
do_not_auto_authorize_if_any_true: Image, compute, retry, candidate, or other resource budget would increase.
A retry, third image, best-of-N, reroll, hidden variant, or replacement output would be added where currently prohibited.
Figma or any currently blocked production surface would be opened.
P5 or another currently unauthorized stage would be entered.
The experiment design, independent variable, reference policy, evaluator contract, or hard gate would change.
A current blocker, quality gate, safety gate, or protocol restriction would be relaxed or bypassed.
There is more than one legal successor or the control-plane state is ambiguous/inconsistent.
required_behavior: Perform idempotency verification before consuming authorization.
Do not ask the user again when the auto-authorization conditions are satisfied.
Record the derived authorization in the authoritative control plane before execution.
Preserve all existing budget ceilings and stop rules.
Treat technical failures according to the frozen protocol; never convert this standing policy into extra retries or extra budget.
If any exclusion condition applies, stop at the authorization boundary and require fresh explicit user authorization.
